title: OAuth callback crashes after recent auth refactor
body: Users are redirected back from OAuth, then the app crashes before session creation. Started after the auth refactor.

title: Security: dependency audit flags transitive token parser
body: npm audit reports a high severity issue in a transitive package used by the token parser.

title: Docs: Docker quickstart still references deprecated env var
body: The Docker quickstart points to ISSUECOMPASS_API_TOKEN, but setup now expects ISSUECOMPASS_GITHUB_TOKEN.

title: Improve indexing performance for very large repositories
body: Indexing repositories with more than 25k files can take several minutes. Maintainers want incremental scans.

title: PR: Fix Windows path handling in file watcher
body: Normalizes path separators before matching watched files. Includes Windows regression test.

title: Intermittent CI failure on Node 20
body: A test in the worker queue package fails intermittently on Node 20 runners.

title: Add sample plugin for custom maintainer workflows
body: A sample plugin would help maintainers understand how to extend IssueCompass scoring.
